doc.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09

title: Nappy leaves New Orleans: Chicago, New York, Ben Pollack
summary: Nappy went north to Chicago and joined Billy Lussick's band, with Ray also in it. He returned to New Orleans, went to New York, then joined Ben Pollack's band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: When you left, who did you play with first when you left the city? Did you come north and join a band up here?

Yeah, I went to Chicago first and joined Billy Lussick's band. Tommy Dossier was in the band and Shimmer and Greg, of course Ray was in the band too. And I went back to New Orleans and I came back to Chicago for a month or so and then I went to New York. And then, well, I played around and then I joined Ben Pollock's band.
